description:
Add the current session configuration to the cart. Calls the add-to-cart endpoint which translates the session's selections into the format required by the external cart service.

On success, returns a **clientKey** (anonymous cart identifier) and a **cartLink** (shareable URL to view the cart). These are also persisted on the session and will appear in all subsequent session responses.

If neither clientKey nor userId is provided, a new anonymous cart is created. Repeat calls add the item again (no idempotency).

**Files are attached automatically.** If the session was linked to a file session (via create_file_session with productConfigSessionId, link_file_session, or create_config_session called with a fileSessionId), the backend resolves the file session from the configuration session — you do NOT need to pass fileSessionId. Only pass fileSessionId to override that durable link with a specific file session.

The cartLink opens the cart on the Smartpress website, where the customer reviews the order and checks out.

clientKey.description: Optional anonymous cart identifier. If omitted, uses the session's persisted clientKey or creates a new cart.

fileSessionId.description: Optional override. Normally omit this — the backend resolves the file session from the durable config<->file link. Only set it to force a specific file session.

jobName.description: Optional custom job name. Defaults to the product name if not provided.

userId.description: Optional user identifier for authenticated carts

name: add_to_cart
